name: Openai-whisper-api
description: Transcribe audio via OpenAI Whisper, Atlas Cloud, or MuAPI speech-to-text APIs.
prompt:
# Audio Transcription APIs

Transcribe a local audio file through OpenAI Whisper (default), Atlas Cloud, or MuAPI speech-to-text.

Use the bundled transcribe.sh script with --provider openai, --provider atlas, or --provider muapi. MuAPI uploads the local file, submits the openai-whisper endpoint, and polls the result with bounded requests.

Set OPENAI_API_KEY, ATLASCLOUD_API_KEY, or MUAPI_API_KEY (MU_API_KEY is also supported). For MuAPI setup and capabilities, see https://muapi.ai/speech-to-text.
